Time-of-Use Interface

Rates and Operands: Basic Settings in Customizing

To enable the rate and the operands to process the consumption periods (technically the result parameters) of the time-of-use
interface, you have to make the following settings:

e Rate for interval meter used by the time-of-use interface (field RTP Category)
e RTP operands
e Atleast one rate fact group

The rate fact group maps in the rate the customer group to which the consumption periods apply.

You make these settings in Customizing for Contract Billing under {Billing Master Data > Rate Structure 3.

Procedure

Completeness of Data to be Billed
To ensure that all consumption and demand is billed, make sure the following applies:

e The periods in the time-of-use interface do not contain any gaps. That is, all season types are alloated to day groups and
the day group covers 24 hours.

e Inthe periods to which formulas are allocated, the corresponding result parameters exist for the output parameters of the
formulas.

e The appropriate RTP operands exist for all result parameters.

e The appropriate rate steps exist for all RTP operands.

Definition of Result Parameters from Inteface as Operand Values
